reader.requirement: At --std 85 every report-name-1 of an INITIATE statement must be the name of a report description entry (RD) in the Report Section; any other name (file-name, report group, report entry, data item, procedure-name, undefined word) must be refused, and several names are legal.

edition-consulted.switches: Edition.Has(2002): a contained program's INITIATE of a container's report needs a GLOBAL FD at 2002+; skipped at 85

reader.edition-search: grep DialectLevel/Edition.Has over ReportWriterBinder.cs; the Reports.Named lookup that enforces SR1 has no edition switch; INITIATE is reserved at every edition (ReservedWords.Table.cs).
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no for SR1 (the RD lookup is identical); yes on the same statement for the 2002+ FD GLOBAL rule, which 1985 lacks and the compiler correctly skips at 85.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_f31_02 exercises the legal half; the refusal half and the contained-program form come from probes p3initterm and p6glob.

probes.printed: COBOL1757 'report-name-1 shall be defined by a report description entry' for PRT (report file), DTL (detail group), DTL-COL (report entry), WS-X, SQ (non-report file), NOSUCH, the second operand of 'INITIATE RPT WS-X', MAIN-PARA
probes.expected: every operand that is not an RD name refused (§1985:XIII.4.4.3 SR1)

probes.printed: INITIATE R-B R-C R-A over two files runs; output B, A, END B, END A; R-C's file empty
probes.expected: several RD names in one INITIATE accepted

probes.printed: --std 85 compiles and runs (DONE, P6.TXT holds IN); --std 2023 COBOL2392 at INITIATE RPT (§2023:14.9.21.3 SR2)
probes.expected: 1985: a GLOBAL report-name is an RD name visible in the contained program, so INITIATE is legal

citations.check: OK  §1985:XIII.4.4.3 SR1  (4.4.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR1
OK  §1985:X.4.6.4 GR1  (║4.6.4 General Rules║)  the text is in GR1

reader.notes: BindInitiate looks each operand up in the visible report table and refuses anything else with COBOL1757; the only edition switch on the path (the 2002 FD GLOBAL rule) is correctly off at 85. Diagnostics cite §2023:14.9.21.3 SR1 at --std 85.

refuter.evidence: Probe refute-1985-166/r3init.cob at --std 85 (runs/r3init-001): an RD that exists but is not visible is refused in both directions: the container's 'INITIATE RIN' of a contained program's RD and the contained program's 'INITIATE RPT' of the container's non-GLOBAL RD each draw COBOL1757 'report-name-1 shall be defined by a report description entry'. The reader's p6glob covers the visible GLOBAL RD. cite.py: OK §1985:XIII.4.4.3 SR1 (the text is in SR1).
